title: The joint exit time and exit location law of a planar Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process on annular sectors and principal axis rectangles
summary: We study the first exit of an isotropic planar Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process from an annular sector, the region bounded by two concentric circular arcs and two radial segments, and obtain explicit eigenfunction expansions for the associated exit functionals. After the ground-state transformation that renders the generator self-adjoint, polar separation reduces the problem to a radial confluent hypergeometric equation whose two independent (Whittaker) solutions of generally non-integral order are combined through a two-radius determinant that fixes the spectrum.
